item.title: Misbegotten: Runaway Nun #1
item.description: In a post-apocalyptic world gone medieval, the Church sends their top monk warrior to infiltrate a renegade scientist’s enclave and kidnap the J-Clone, the Lord’s vat-born twin. Saving the holy clone from the cross forces, the monk must confront the truth of his own (very immaculate) birth. Clones of Marilyn Monroe, Hitler, Gandhi and Jesus… oh my! Misbegotten is cyber-punk religion gone mad!

item.title: Misbegotten: Runaway Nun #2
item.description: The Pope orders the kidnapping of the Lord’s body double from the Harlequin Island. Father Elano makes his way to the Domus Mariae, the carrier-turned-abbey. Motley gladiators and augmented Steampunk Templars clash. And Klaudette: the one-eyed geisha blood trafficker from the replica ghetto enters the mix.

item.title: Misbegotten: Runaway Nun #3
item.description: Sir Gottfrey arrives aboard Domus Mariae searching for Double-M. Father Micon takes the bullets intended for Elano and dies in his disciple’s arms. On Harlequin Island, Brother Ziggy, a Sigmund Freud-replika-turned-monk, takes runaway replikas to the rendezvous point with the Franciscans’ submarine that has Elano on board. Once inside the replika ghetto, Elano stumbles into the crossfire between two rival gangs and ends up captured by Klaudette.

item.title: Misbegotten: Runaway Nun #4
item.description: Klaudette, the one-eyed geisha, stages her latest show: the raping and killing of Father Elano. With the help of his feral Cannies, King Richie’s renegade warriors crash her party and throw her to the sharks. Later, Richie and Elano strike a deal: to aid the Jesuit in his pursuit of J-Clone, Richie will facilitate Elano’s entrance into Sir Gottfrey’s stronghold in exchange for a free pass off the island.
